nodes.description: Owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates all privileged functions (delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress) and is the whitelist bypass in ensure()
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated with unchecked native arithmetic
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances
Private mapping _onSaleNum counting how many sales an address has performed
Private mapping canSale, whitelist of addresses permitted to transfer
Private _minSale minimum permitted transfer value, set by init()
Private _maxSale maximum permitted transfer value, set by init()
Private _saleNum maximum number of sales per address, set by init()
Whitelisted trade address used by ensure() to bypass sale limits; set by setTradeAddress()
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor
Constant decimals = 18 used for scaling in init() and the constructor
Token name string, assigned in the constructor
Token symbol string, assigned in the constructor
Constant UNI router address 0x7a25...488D, granted infinite allowance in the constructor
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
Internal view ensure(address,address,uint) computing the UNI pair and applying owner/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist plus condition() limits
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) performing allowance checks, ensure() gate and unchecked balance mutations
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing the allowance mapping for msg.sender
Internal view condition(address,uint) enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints
Public payable delegate(address,bytes) that owner-only performs an arbitrary delegatecall via a.delegatecall(b)
Public owner-only init(uint,uint,uint) configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
Public payable batchSend(address[],uint) distributing tokens in a loop with unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length
Public owner-only setTradeAddress(address) writing tradeAddress
Internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing a deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256 and an embedded init code hash
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balances and an infinite UNI allowance
EVM msg.sender, used as the implicit from/caller and as the owner check in every privileged function
Arbitrary delegatecall executed inside the token contract with attacker-influenced target and calldata
Unchecked native uint arithmetic (balance mutations and total = _value * _tos.length) without SafeMath, allowing overflow/underflow

Loop counter i in batchSend

edges.reason: transfer() immediately calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom() calls ensure() which enforces owner/whitelist/limit gates before balances change
ensure() calls condition() to enforce _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale restrictions
ensure() derives the UNI pair address through pairFor()
ensure() reads owner to grant a whitelist bypass to transfers involving the owner
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to allow whitelisted sellers to bypass limits
ensure() reads tradeAddress to bypass sale limits for the designated trade address
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale count limit
condition() reads _minSale to bound the minimum transfer value
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the maximum transfer value
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked native subtraction/addition
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every successful transfer
transferFrom() performs raw uint balance math without SafeMath
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate() invokes a.delegatecall(b), an arbitrary low-level delegatecall
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
batchSend() subtracts total and adds _value to recipients using unchecked arithmetic
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply
constructor grants an infinite allowance to the UNI router
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply parameter
constructor sets name from _name
constructor sets symbol from _symbol
msg.sender is used as the implicit _from in transfer()
msg.sender is compared to _from and used as the spender in transferFrom()
msg.sender is the owner key written by approve()
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner and initial balance to msg.sender
_to flows into transfer()
_value flows into transfer()
_from drives the whitelist comparisons inside ensure()
_to is used in the owner comparison inside ensure()
_value is forwarded from ensure() into condition()
_from is the source account of transferFrom()
_to is the destination account of transferFrom()
_value drives the unchecked balance and allowance subtractions in transferFrom()
_spender is the allowance key in approve()
_value is the allowance amount in approve()
_from selects _onSaleNum[_from] in condition()
_value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale in condition()
target address a flows into the delegatecall of delegate()
calldata bytes b flow into the delegatecall of delegate()
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init()
token is scaled into _minSale by init()
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init()
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend()
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection in batchSend()
addr is written to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress()
_name is stored into the name state variable by the constructor
_symbol is stored into the symbol state variable by the constructor
_supply is scaled into totalSupply by the constructor
pairFor() returns the pair address stored in the local _UNI of ensure()
local _UNI participates in the whitelist comparison inside ensure()
_tos.length contributes to the local total in batchSend()
local total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] and subtracted in batchSend()
